WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, 
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country, 
           c_login AS customer_login, c_email_address AS customer_email_address, d_year AS dyear, 
           SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type 
    FROM (customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk) 
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, 
             c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, 
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country, 
           c_login AS customer_login, c_email_address AS customer_email_address, d_year AS dyear, 
           SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type 
    FROM (customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk) 
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, 
             c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), store_growth_ratio AS (
    SELECT customer_id, year_total / LAG(year_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY dyear) AS ratio 
    FROM store_sales_agg WHERE year_total > 0
), web_growth_ratio AS (
    SELECT customer_id, year_total / LAG(year_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY dyear) AS ratio 
    FROM web_sales_agg WHERE year_total > 0
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
       t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address 
FROM (store_sales_agg AS t_s_firstyear JOIN store_growth_ratio ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = store_growth_ratio.customer_id) 
JOIN (store_sales_agg AS t_s_secyear JOIN store_growth_ratio ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = store_growth_ratio.customer_id) 
    ON t_s_firstyear.dyear + 1 = t_s_secyear.dyear AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' 
       AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND store_growth_ratio.ratio > 1 
JOIN (web_sales_agg AS t_w_firstyear JOIN web_growth_ratio ON t_w_firstyear.customer_id = web_growth_ratio.customer_id) 
    ON t_s_firstyear.dyear + 1 = t_w_firstyear.dyear AND t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id 
       AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND web_growth_ratio.ratio > 1 
JOIN (web_sales_agg AS t_w_secyear JOIN web_growth_ratio ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = web_growth_ratio.customer_id) 
    ON t_s_firstyear.dyear + 2 = t_w_secyear.dyear AND t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id 
       AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND web_growth_ratio.ratio > 1 
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, 
         t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address LIMIT 100
